rulings.comment: The land can be targeted by land-destroying spells and the spell will resolve, but the land will simply not be destroyed.
If Consecrate Land enters attached to a land that's enchanted by other Auras, those Auras are put into their owners' graveyards.
A permanent with indestructible can't be destroyed, but it can still be sacrificed, exiled, put into a graveyard, and so on.
